approved: Customs Amendment (Australia-United Arab Emirates Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement Implementation) Bill 2025

Introduced the Customs Tariff Amendment (Australia-United Arab Emirates Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement Implementation) Bill 2025 to establish preferential customs duty rates for UAE originating goods, maintain tariff concessions and continue excise-equivalent duties on specified fuel, alcohol, tobacco and petroleum products.

Declared that the Customs Amendment and Customs Tariff Amendment bills implementing the Australia-United Arab Emirates Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement would stand referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration.

Moved a timetable for consideration of the Universities Accord (Cutting Student Debt by 20 Per Cent) Bill 2025, the Early Childhood Education and Care (Strengthening Regulation of Early Education) Bill 2025 and Australia-United Arab Emirates trade bills from Tuesday, 29 July 2025 to Thursday, 31 July 2025, including limits on debate and scheduled votes.

Moved that the Customs Amendment and Customs Tariff Amendment bills be read a second time, outlining their implementation of the Australia-United Arab Emirates Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, tariff preferences and expected benefits for trade, investment and exporters; the question was agreed to and the bills were read a second time.
Customs Amendment (Australia-United Arab Emirates Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement Implementation) Act 2025
